products.name: Coda AI
products.note: All-in-one doc AI; automation; team data; enterprise governance features

profile_text.body:
Coda is a collaborative workspace platform that, according to its own site, blends the flexibility of documents, the structure of spreadsheets, the power of applications, and the intelligence of AI into a single product. The company describes its platform as enabling anyone to build time-saving solutions using formulas, buttons, and automations, with the stated goal of replacing niche apps in a team's tool stack.

The company's primary AI product is Coda AI, categorized as an all-in-one document AI offering that includes automation, team data management, and enterprise governance features. The site notes that Coda is rebranding under the name Superhuman Docs, describing it as more than a name change and positioning it as the best place for teams and AI to work together, with additions that include enterprise-ready databases and new AI Views.
